question: Who was appointed as Chairman of the national selection panel by the BCCI's Cricket Advisory Committee (CAC) in March 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Sunil Joshi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunil Bandacharya Joshi** is a former Indian cricketer and current India National Cricket Team selector.
 
• He batted left-handed and bowled slow left arm spin as an all-rounder.
 
• Sunil Joshi was named as the Indian** national team's Chief Selector on March 4, 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narendra Deepchand Hirwan**i is an Indian leg spin bowler.
 
• He is well known for his performance in his Test debut.
 
• **Murali Kartik** is an Indian cricket pundit and former cricketer who played for India on and off between 2000 and 2002.
 
• **Rajesh Chauhan represented India in 21 Tests and 35 One Day Internationals.**
 
• He was a member of the Indian spin trio** Kumble-Raju-Chauhan**.
